name: 28751 · Maggie Valley, NC
findings: ZIP 28751 (Maggie Valley) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28751 (Maggie Valley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28751 (Maggie Valley) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
